notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary + Performance Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 [b]Aestik’s 1 Year Anniversary![/b] 🎉[/h1][p]Today we celebrate [b]one year of Aestik[/b] — thank you all SO much for joining us on this journey. 💜
It’s been an absolute blast, and we couldn’t have done it without your support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/1682c68f6172946e89868d7ee98ca252be7c63d7.png"][/img][/p][p]To mark the occasion, we’re rolling out a special update:
✨ Improved game performance → the game should now run [b]smoother than ever[/b]![/p][p]Thanks again for being part of our adventure - we appreciate you! 🥂


Also, feel free to check out our [b]new upcoming game[/b] 💜

[b][h3]🍃 New Ability System + Quality of Life Additions & More! 🍃[/h3][/b]

Hi folks (:

We're thrilled to announce that we've just updated the demo once again!

We made a lot of "quality of life" additions & changes to improve your experience with Aestik.

notes.title: New Quest Line incl. New Decision + More Accessibility Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png[/img]


Hi folks (:

We’re super pleased to announce that we’ve just updated the demo!

We made some changes in terms of accessibility (yes, Aestik becomes more accessible by the day :D) as well as adding a bit more content for you guys to test out.


[olist][b][*] NEW QUEST LINE + NEW DECISION[/b]
[list]
[*]Introducing [b]Oddfrey on his strange quest to find nihilism in his life 🍡[/b]
It's the Oddguy's mission to preach nihilism, but poor Oddfrey stands out among the crowd - he's simply too happy in life. Help him get back on track, find nihilism, and become the true nihilistic self that he yearns to be.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/fb853ed7a3b7355a2fbf0749024400b9f18b6095.png[/img]

[b][*] SETTINGS MENU[/b]
[list]
[*] Aestik now has its very own [b]settings menu[/b]! 

[*]With the new update, you will be able to customize your player experience even more as you can now [b]individually adjust the volume of Aestik’s background music as well as SFX[/b]. 

[*]After doing some playtesting recently, we became aware of the fact that [b]screenshake[/b] can be off-putting or straight-up irritating to some players which is why we implemented the option to [b]turn it off/on[/b] if you’d like. 

[*]Also, are you guilty of running Aestik on a computer that is closer to a toaster than the high-end gaming PC of your dreams? We got you covered! We’ve implemented the option to [b]change the game's resolution[/b] to … well anything between Aestik-if-it-was-pixel-art and crisp-as-morning-dew -> you choose! 

[*]And lastly, is your eyesight getting worse? Me too, dude. But all jokes aside, too small of a screen or losing your glasses is no longer an issue because the [b]size of the dialogue boxes is finally adjustable[/b] - so, happy reading, everyone![/list][/olist]

Anyway, it’s getting late - DON’T FORGET TO WISHLIST AESTIK AND TELL ALL YOUR FRIENDS, FAMILY, PETS AND PLANTS ABOUT IT TOO! 🤍⚔️

Much love,
Julia & Nic

notes.title: Button Rebinding + German Localization Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png[/img]

[h3]Introducing:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Button Rebinding
[*]German Localization[/list]
[h3]Button Rebinding[/h3]
An accessibility feature which we wanted to implement for a long time is now finally available for Aestik's public Steam demo: Button Rebinding. 
Now you can choose custom keys and decide which action will be triggered by which button (works on both keyboard and gamepad).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/8f415e9dc83f47c55515d7d70ff9b41d63ef17e1.png[/img]

[h3]German Localization[/h3]
Also, the demo is now completely translated into German! This includes all in-game texts, such as the game's menu, the intro cutscene, character dialogue and object descriptions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/c2e2114cbf1534f7532575fed0ffcda9b6951877.png[/img]


✨ Feel free to check out an [url=https://discord.gg/vpfhKvuCFw]extended demo[/url] (twice the playtime) over on Discord which was also newly updated to feature key rebinding and German localization (:

✨ As always, you can keep up with the latest news on Aestik over on [url=https://twitter.com/hooded_traveler]Twitter[/url] or through our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/NicTheThicc]devlog series on Youtube[/url], see you there!
